questions.title: India's AH-64E Apache attack helicopters join US troops in Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026
questions.subject: defence
questions.q: With reference to “India's AH-64E Apache attack helicopters join US troops in Exercise Yudh Abhyas 2026”, consider the following statements:
items: Exercise Red Flag 2026 features integrated operational drills with Indian Army AH-64E Apache attack helicopters and United States Army forces.
Approximately 600 personnel from both sides are participating in this bilateral exercise.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
